summary: Shift two joined words and return the high half for left shifts or low half for right shifts.
Admit every unsigned count, capping at 32 in clamp mode or reducing modulo 32 in wrap mode.
Use repeated inputs to verify a register-only rotation kernel with finite execution and preserved memory.
remaining: Four selected forms and both wrap-mode rotation kernels have complete proofs. Raw-module parsing, register declaration validation, architecture-name validation and hardware correspondence remain excluded.

A typed decoder accepts exactly a word-register destination
and three word operands, preserving the true-or-false execution guard.

Its result is specified
by Lean's standard word rotation, for arbitrary input and count.

It provides a
finite execution witness and a correctness result for every completed execution,
while preserving memory and other registers.
